This is highway 12 in Thailand. This image tells me something about the foresight, thinking ahead, creativity and level of environmental awareness of the people of Thailand.

They keep those trees and build a new highway around them. It will be a very big highway with big tall trees in line in the middle. 

I can't imagine what would our Cambodian Ministry of Infrastructure do with those trees.

I think it's good for me to be aware of something start from this, so that if I end up being in a position where I have to make important decisions and lead, I will do it in a right way.

You traveled far today, but today was an easy day. Tomorrow you will see some serious mountains.

Much of the environmental foresight you see in Thailand is a result of their King who recently died.  Strong and intelligent leadership is required to mold a nation in the right direction, and even then it is a difficult job with so many forces working against you.

For Cambodia, it begins with cleaning up the garbage, providing proper means to dispose of garbage, educating the people on garbage disposal, and putting an end to the burning of garbage and plastic.

Without clean air, there is no such thing as good health, and the people of Cambodia will never be healthy until they are taught not to pollute their air, land, and water.

Unfortunately for you, your children and your grandchildren, this is not a priority for Cambodian leaders of today or the Cambodian government.
